scripts.gate: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test

pnpm.comment: One line of web3.js only. @coral-xyz/anchor 0.32.1 depends on ^1.69, and a second major in the tree means two copies of PublicKey/Transaction — a mismatch that surfaces as a failed signature or an undecodable account at runtime, not as a build error.
pnpm.peerComment: @solana-mobile/mobile-wallet-adapter-protocol declares react-native as a required peer, so pnpm installs it — 253 packages that never execute in a desktop treasury dashboard. The peer stays unmet on purpose; the mobile adapter is only reachable from a React Native host.
